effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[On Play] [Main] By suspending this Tamer and placing the top card of one of your [Light Fang] or [Night Claw] trait trait Digimon as that Digimon's bottom digivolution card, 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card in your hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
